readme: The client words apps/api/src/modules/tickets/vocabulary.ts can put on a row, for the fields whose de-para is a table. Both suites read this file: the API asserts its vocabulary produces exactly these words, and apps/web asserts each one has pt-BR copy of its own — the same guarantee the two had in a single test back when the maps lived in the web. `product` is out on purpose: its de-para is a rule, not a table, so the set is open and no list can close it, and an unnamed benefit shows raw by design. `enrollmentType` is identity on the API side: the service translates the EI's pair on write (enrollment-type.ts), so the column already holds the client word — it is here so the web is held to copy for each of the five.
